content.text: The image is labeled with action points in numbers. Give a list of actions that need to be completed in order to cook the meat. Choices:  A. [7 (open meat package), 6 (open pot lid)]. B. [3 (turn on stove), 7 (open meat package), 8 (open fish package)]. C. [3 (turn on stove), 9 (open pot lid), 7 (open meat package)]. D. [3 (turn on stove), 6 (open pot lid), 7 (open meat package)]. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
